appFullyLoaded: Workbook fully loaded — formulas recalculate live, rows/columns editable.
appRangeMustBeVector: {range} must be a single row or a single column of cells.
appCopyValuesOnly: {range} copied as values only ({cells} cells): styles are kept only up to {max} cells.
appSheetStillIndexing: The sheet is still indexing — try again in a moment.
appPrintNothing: The sheet has nothing to print.
appPrintTooLarge: The print range is too large — set a smaller print area on the Page Layout tab.
appPrintTitlesLimit: Print titles repeat at most 21 rows.
appVisualHintText: Drag to move · handles to resize · double-click to edit text
appVisualHintEdit: Drag to move · handles to resize · double-click to edit
appVisualHint: Drag to move · handles to resize
appValuesRangeTitle: Values range for {name} — a single row or column, e.g. B2:B13
appCategoriesRangeTitle: Category labels range for {name} — a single row or column, e.g. A2:A13
appAutoSaveTitle: AutoSave is available for cloud files only
appAutoSaveTip: AutoSave (every 30 seconds and when the window loses focus)
appRemoveDuplicatesNote: Rows in the selection that duplicate an earlier row (comparing every column, ignoring letter case) are removed; the rest shift up.
appLinkAddressLabel: Address — a web page (https://…) or a sheet reference (Sheet1!A1)
appInsertShapeTitle: Insert a shape at the selection
appSparklinesTitle: In-cell minicharts, one per selected row (placed right of the selection)
appPrintTitlesTitle: Print titles — rows {rows} repeat on every page
appPrintTitlesHint: Rows repeated at the top of every printed page
appUseInFormulaTitle: Insert a defined name into the formula
appUseInFormulaNeedsEmptyCell: Select an empty cell first — inserting the name would replace this cell's contents
appCreateFromSelectionTitle: Create names from the selection labels
appCreateNamesNeedsData: Select labels plus the data they name.
appWatchEmpty: Select cells, then click Add watch.
appCalcManualOn: Manual calculation on — use Calculate Now to update.
appWorkbookNoPivot: No pivot tables in this workbook.
appErrorCheckingDetail: Scan the sheet for error values
appCheckingErrors: Scanning the whole sheet for errors…
appAdvancedFilterTitle: Custom filter conditions on a column
appTextToColumnsTitle: Split a single column of text (fully-loaded workbooks)
appWhatIfTitle: Solve an input for a target value
appGoalSeekNeedsFormula: Set cell must contain a formula.
appGoalSeekByCellNotNumber: By changing cell must hold a plain number or be empty.
appGoalSeekTargetNotNumber: Set cell did not produce a number.
appOutlineGroupTitle: Group the selected rows or columns into an outline
appOutlineUngroupTitle: Remove one outline level from the selection
appTranslatePrompt: Translate the text in the selected range into {language} and write the translations back to the same cells.
appPasteSpecialTitle: Paste only values, formulas, or formatting
appFormatAsTableTitle: Create a real Excel table over the selection (headers in its first row)
appCellStylesTitle: Apply one of Excel's built-in cell styles to the selection
